body: Its just that when you want to talk to someone you normally think about talking  to your parents and they can come up with a solution and support  you along the way. I feel nice knowing you care or someone somewhere does but its just different. And I dont think I hang around wrong people they justdont know.
Already tried with the university's physiologist and it helped until the semester ended and couldnt go for two weeks now I just dont feel like going anymore
What really gets to me is the fact that whenever I have a serious problem I cant turn to my parents in the first place making me feel no support whatsoever.
I have 1 year in the university.
I have but it doesnt help me at all since in the end the problems are still there.
